title: Fourier coefficient estimator program
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be finite, and let $m\in\mathbb N$. The random-example learning program draws a batch of $m$ independent uniform labeled examples, returns their empirical Fourier coefficient on $S$ as a rational number, and charges $m(|S|+1)$ local computation steps.
